title: Panel Package Manifest (panel.yaml)
description: Contract for a panel package under panels/<panel_id>/panel.yaml. Drives panel discovery, template selection, input/output contracts, QA gates, and golden-case regression.

panel_id.description: Stable identifier, lowercase snake_case. Must match the directory name under panels/.

display_name.description: Human-readable name shown in the web UI and report front matter.

version.description: Panel package semver. Bumped on rule/template changes.

status.description: Lifecycle. active = serving customers; pilot = internal validation only; deprecated = scheduled for removal.

aliases.description: Alternate identifiers (legacy names, shortcodes). Project detector tries these for back-compat.

project_detector_rules.description: Heuristics for auto-detecting this panel from Excel filename / sheet content.

enhancer.description: Fully-qualified Python class path of a PanelEnhancer (module:Class). Empty string = no enhancement (NoopEnhancer). Same enhancer can serve multiple panels (e.g. CRC358Enhancer serves both crc_358_msi and crc_301_msi).

default_template.description: Template id (from the templates list) used when the web form does not override. Must match exactly one templates[].id.

templates.description: All templates this panel can render. At least one must be active for the default_template to resolve.

file.description: Path relative to the panel directory, typically templates/<id>.docx

processors.description: Optional override of the panel-level processors chain for this specific template.

mappings.description: Excel→template variable mappings. Paths relative to the repo root (typically config/mapping.yaml).

rules.description: Panel-specific business rule files. Paths relative to the panel directory (rules/*.yaml) or repo root (config/*.yaml).

input_contract.description: What the input Excel must look like for this panel.

required_columns.description: Per-table required columns. Keys are sheet names, values are arrays of column names.

template_contract.description: What variables/loops the template must reference. Validated at render time.

required_variables.description: Scalar {{ var }} placeholders that must appear in the template.

required_lists.description: List names referenced by {%tr for row in <list> %} loops.

required_markers.description: Structural markers that must occur exactly once in the selected DOCX template.

required_table_structures.description: Per-table column count + required header row.

context_contracts.description: Named context-contract fixture files (under context_contracts/) used by regression tests.

processors.description: Default chain of post-render DOCX processors (e.g. blank_page_cleanup, toc_refresh, final_refresh_cleanup). Empty array = no post-processing.

golden_cases.description: Reviewed-case fixtures used as regression gates. Each entry runs a command and expects a QA status.
